new_pmalloc.origin: Unmodified user-provided pmalloc_posix.hpp snapshot; upstream commit unknown

adapter: The same external malloc-family ABI adapter is compiled against both headers. Neither allocator header is edited.
comparison: Old and new pmalloc are measured together with mimalloc and glibc in fresh processes, sequentially, with allocator order balanced by a Williams square across every 4 runs. Results on another host need not match previous measurements.
